nodes.trans: Welcome. How can I help you?

replies.text: 어제 이 니트를 샀는데 너무 작아요.
replies.pron: eoje i niteureul sanneunde neomu jagayo.
replies.trans: I bought this sweater yesterday, but it's too small.
I'm here to return this.
There's a hole in this sweater.

nodes.trans: Sure. Is there a problem with it?

replies.trans: It doesn't fit.
No, I just changed my mind.

nodes.text: 아, 정말 죄송합니다. 영수증 가지고 계세요?
nodes.pron: a, jeongmal joesonghamnida. yeongsujeung gajigo gyeseyo?
nodes.trans: Oh, I'm really sorry. Do you have the receipt?

replies.trans: Yes, here it is.
No, I lost it.

nodes.trans: Okay. Do you have the receipt?

replies.trans: Yes, here you go.
Sorry, I don't have the receipt.

nodes.trans: Thank you. Would you like an exchange or a refund?

replies.text: 한 사이즈 큰 걸로 바꿀 수 있어요?
replies.pron: han saijeu keun geollo bakkul su isseoyo?
replies.trans: Can I swap it for one size up?
Do you have other colors?
A refund, please.

nodes.text: 잠시만요... 죄송해요, 지금 라지 사이즈가 품절이에요.
nodes.pron: jamsimanyo... joesonghaeyo, jigeum raji saijeuga pumjeorieyo.
nodes.trans: One moment... Sorry, the large is sold out right now.

replies.trans: Is there a large in another color?
When will it be back in stock?
Then I'll just get a refund.

nodes.text: 다음 주에 들어올 거예요. 들어오면 연락드릴까요?
nodes.pron: da-eum jue deureool geoyeyo. deureomyeon yeollakdeurilkkayo?
nodes.trans: It should come in next week. Shall we call you when it arrives?

replies.text: 네, 연락 주세요. 제 번호 알려 드릴게요.
replies.pron: ne, yeollak juseyo. je beonho allyeo deurilgeyo.
replies.trans: Yes, please call me. I'll give you my number.
No, I'll just get a refund.

nodes.text: 검정이랑 네이비가 있어요. 어떤 걸로 하시겠어요?
nodes.pron: geomjeong-irang neibiga isseoyo. eotteon geollo hasigesseoyo?
nodes.trans: We have black and navy. Which one would you like?

replies.trans: Black, please.
I'll go with navy.

nodes.text: 여기 있습니다. 한번 입어 보시겠어요? 탈의실은 저쪽이에요.
nodes.pron: yeogi itseumnida. hanbeon ibeo bosigesseoyo? taruisireun jeojjogieyo.
nodes.trans: Here you go. Would you like to try it on? The fitting room is over there.

replies.trans: Sure, I'll try it on.
That's okay. I'll just take this one.

nodes.trans: How is it? Does it fit?

replies.trans: It fits perfectly.

replies.text: 음, 그래도 안 맞네요. 그냥 환불해 주실 수 있어요?
replies.pron: eum, geuraedo an manneyo. geunyang hwanbulhae jusil su isseoyo?
replies.trans: Hmm, it still doesn't fit. Could I just get a refund?

nodes.text: 네, 결제하신 카드로 환불해 드릴게요. 카드 주시겠어요?
nodes.pron: ne, gyeoljehasin kadeuro hwanbulhae deurilgeyo. kadeu jusigesseoyo?
nodes.trans: Sure, we'll refund it to the card you paid with. Could I have the card?

replies.trans: Sure, here it is.
Here. When will the refund go through?

nodes.text: 영수증이 없으면 환불은 어려워요. 대신 적립금으로 드릴 수 있어요.
nodes.pron: yeongsujeung-i eopseumyeon hwanbureun eoryeowoyo. daesin jeongnipgeumeuro deuril su isseoyo.
nodes.trans: Without a receipt we can't do a refund. But we can give you store credit.

replies.trans: Okay, store credit is fine.

replies.text: 제 카드로 조회해 주실 수 있어요?
replies.pron: je kadeuro johoehae jusil su isseoyo?
replies.trans: Could you look it up with my card?

nodes.text: 네, 한번 볼게요... 아, 찾았어요. 그럼 교환하실래요, 환불하실래요?
nodes.pron: ne, hanbeon bolgeyo... a, chajasseoyo. geureom gyohwanhasillaeyo, hwanbulhasillaeyo?
nodes.trans: Sure, let me check... Oh, found it. So, exchange or refund?

replies.text: 한 사이즈 큰 걸로 바꿔 주세요.
replies.pron: han saijeu keun geollo bakkwo juseyo.
replies.trans: Please swap it for one size up.
A refund, please.

nodes.text: 교환 다 됐습니다. 새 영수증 여기 있어요. 감사합니다!
nodes.pron: gyohwan da dwaetseumnida. sae yeongsujeung yeogi isseoyo. gamsahamnida!
nodes.trans: Your exchange is done. Here's your new receipt. Thank you!

nodes.text: 환불 처리됐습니다. 카드사에 따라 삼 일에서 오 일 정도 걸려요. 안녕히 가세요!
nodes.pron: hwanbul cheoridwaetseumnida. kadeusa-e ttara sam ireseo o il jeongdo geollyeoyo. annyeonghi gaseyo!
nodes.trans: Your refund is done. It takes about three to five days, depending on your card company. Goodbye!

nodes.text: 적립금 넣어 드렸어요. 일 년 동안 쓰실 수 있어요. 감사합니다!
nodes.pron: jeongnipgeum neoeo deuryeosseoyo. il nyeon dong-an sseusil su isseoyo. gamsahamnida!
nodes.trans: I've added the store credit. You can use it for a year. Thank you!

nodes.text: 네, 들어오면 바로 연락드릴게요. 안녕히 가세요!
nodes.pron: ne, deureomyeon baro yeollakdeurilgeyo. annyeonghi gaseyo!
nodes.trans: Sure, we'll call you as soon as it comes in. Goodbye!
